# Ahmed Ibrahim Asl

> Portfolio of Ahmed Ibrahim Asl, an Embedded Systems & IoT R&D Engineer, teaching assistant, and technical educator based in Egypt.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://eng-asl.com/): Overview of Ahmed's embedded systems, IoT, robotics, research, teaching work, and free engineering tools.
- [Work](https://eng-asl.com/work/): Embedded firmware, robotics, IoT telemetry, secure hardware, OTA management, Flutter, and interface projects.
- [About](https://eng-asl.com/about/): Experience, university teaching, technical capabilities, publications, CV, and workshops.
- [Engineering notes](https://eng-asl.com/notes/): Published engineering field notes, Security documentation, Linux and cybersecurity walkthroughs, and the Learn With Me series.
- [Tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/): Searchable electronics calculators and guided engineering workbenches.
- [Contact](https://eng-asl.com/contact/): Email and professional profiles.

## Notes and technical articles

- [Security Field Notes](https://eng-asl.com/notes/security/): Structured cybersecurity reconnaissance, hardening, and protocol notes.
- [Footprinting folder](https://eng-asl.com/notes/security/footprinting/): Service and protocol reconnaissance notes covering banners, default ports, configuration hardening, anonymous access, and enumeration techniques.
  - [FTP Footprinting](https://eng-asl.com/notes/security/footprinting/ftp/) ([Markdown version](https://eng-asl.com/notes/security/footprinting/ftp.md)): Essential FTP fundamentals, Linux server configuration with vsFTPd, and practical footprinting and enumeration techniques.

## Public projects

- [Embedded Systems & IoT](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/): Firmware, custom electronics, PCB design, and connected hardware systems from signal to portal.
  - [Top Wood RFID Catalog](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/topwood-rfid-catalog/): Built the RFID system behind Top Wood's LTOP Interactive Catalog. A custom ESP8266 + RC522 board reads product cards and talks to the catalog over the local Wi-Fi network, so tapping a card opens that product straight away. The board serves its own setup portal for reading, writing and verifying cards and for Wi-Fi setup, and ships with a one-click Windows installer. I also designed a 3D-printable two-part enclosure for the board in SolidWorks: the board screws onto four standoffs at its real mounting holes, the lid carries the Top Wood name and a tap-card target over the RC522 antenna, and every KiCad 3D model was checked for clearance.
  - [Aqua Sync 2.0.0](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/aqua-sync/): Upgraded an existing ESP32-based Aqua Sync system by programming a 7-inch CrowPanel HMI to interface with 10 one-wire temperature sensors and a DHT sensor, connecting two embedded boards, and implementing OTA updates. Designed the interface in Figma before building the final UI in SquareLine Studio.
  - [ToolGuard](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/toolguard/): Designed and developed a prototype system to manage borrowing and returning shared tools. I handled hardware programming, mobile UI/UX design, full Flutter application development, and Firebase integration for real-time data storage and tracking. The system monitors tool availability, tracks borrowed items and overdue returns, and provides notifications through a clean mobile interface.
  - [Fall Detection System](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/fall-detection-system/): A fall-detection prototype documented through a Raspberry Pi and relay setup, a computer-vision development demo, and a companion smart-home control interface with normal and alarm-locked device states.
  - [Real-Time Muscle Activity Monitoring](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/muscle-activity-monitoring/): Developed a wearable muscle activity monitoring system using the MyoWare 2.0 EMG sensor and a custom Flutter mobile application for real-time visualization and analysis. Surface electrodes capture muscle signals, which stream to the app as live graphs and metrics including peak values, mean amplitude, and signal variability. Firebase provides real-time data synchronization and cloud storage.
  - [MediaMate](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/mediamate/): A medication dispenser prototype with a companion mobile interface for patient and doctor access, medication schedules, and adherence tracking.
  - [Smart Mosque Model](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/smart-mosque-model/): Applied IoT model for automatically managing mosque energy and ventilation.
  - [AgriBot Architecture](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/agribot-architecture/): An agricultural robot that combines crop selection, fertilizer recommendations, leaf-disease diagnosis, and remote device management through Firewire OTA.
  - [Wireless ROV Control System](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/wireless-rov-control/): An ESP32 control system with NRF24L01+ radios for bidirectional telemetry and commands between an operator and a remotely operated vehicle.
  - [Multi-MCU Security Lock](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/multi-mcu-security-lock/): An access-control prototype that separates the human-machine interface from the electronic control unit to limit the effect of physical tampering.
  - [Firewire Enterprise OTA](https://eng-asl.com/work/embedded-iot/firewire-enterprise-ota/): A remote firmware and hardware management platform for edge devices, with version tracking, device assignment, and health telemetry.
- [Robotics](https://eng-asl.com/work/robotics/): Physical autonomous builds that sense, actuate, and respond in real environments.
  - [AVR32 Autonomous Car](https://eng-asl.com/work/robotics/amit-avr-autonomous-car/): Graduation project for the AMIT Embedded Systems Diploma: an AVR-based autonomous car that detects and avoids obstacles using an ultrasonic sensor and servo motor.
  - [MegaSumo Autonomous Robot](https://eng-asl.com/work/robotics/megasumo-autonomous-robot/): Competition firmware and sensor logic for an autonomous sumo robot, built around fast control loops and arena-tuned behavior.
  - [Rocket League ESP32 Car](https://eng-asl.com/work/robotics/rocket-league-esp32/): A wireless ESP32 vehicle controlled with synchronized PS4 controller input over Bluetooth.
  - [Human Follower Car](https://eng-asl.com/work/robotics/human-follower-car/): A mobile robot that combines ultrasonic and vision sensing to detect and follow a moving person.
- [Apps & UI Design](https://eng-asl.com/work/apps-ui/): Companion mobile apps, Flutter interfaces, and control surfaces built for hardware products.
  - [Plant Care AI](https://eng-asl.com/work/apps-ui/plant-care-ai/): A plant-monitoring system that combines soil and temperature sensing, leaf-disease detection, and a Flutter app.
  - [AgriBot Mobile App UI](https://eng-asl.com/work/apps-ui/agribot-mobile-ui/): A mobile interface for monitoring AgriBot sensor data and controlling the graduation-project robot.
  - [Dad4Hire Mobile App UI](https://eng-asl.com/work/apps-ui/dad4hire-mobile-ui/): Task flows and mobile interface design for the Dad4Hire concept developed with Google DSC at EELU.
- [B2B Technical Modernization](https://eng-asl.com/work/web-development/): Enterprise web architecture, searchable product catalogs, and infrastructure migrations for industrial firms.
  - [Biovety International](https://eng-asl.com/work/web-development/biovety-website/): Website redesign, catalogue structure, domain, hosting, and business email setup for a veterinary health business moving from its legacy Eurokem presence to the new BioVety identity.
  - [Miraj Academy](https://eng-asl.com/work/web-development/miraj-academy-website/): Website design for technical training and engineering R&D, connecting visitors with services, engineering projects, courses, and learning resources.
- [Video & Media](https://eng-asl.com/work/video-media/): Editing, motion graphics, and visual documentation for engineering communities.
  - [Dragons Battle Final Call](https://eng-asl.com/work/video-media/dragons-battle-promo/): A short competition-registration video edited with rapid cuts and typographic overlays.

## Free engineering tools

- [Guided workbenches](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/workbenches/): Project generators, academic planning, control simulation, embedded code, security commands, and battery estimation.
- [Circuit design tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/circuit-design/): Interactive calculators for circuits, component values, timing, power supplies, and control logic.
- [Text and encoding tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/text-encoding/): ROT transformations plus ASCII and hexadecimal conversions with worked examples.
- [Unit conversion tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/conversions/): Temperature and capacitance converters with explicit units and assumptions.
- [Number-system tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/number-systems/): Binary, hexadecimal, complements, shifts, and multi-base conversion tools.
- [Physics and math tools](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/physics-math/): Motion, force, wavelength, frequency, percentages, roots, and logarithm calculators.
- [Satellite](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/satellite/): Plan orbit geometry, spacecraft power, propagation timing, and end-to-end satellite links with connected engineering calculators.
- [RF Engineering](https://eng-asl.com/tools/category/rf-engineering/): Plan carriers and antennas, trace RF paths, evaluate receiver noise, and estimate multiple-access capacity.
- [Gradify](https://eng-asl.com/tools/gradify/): University GPA calculation and a Delta Engineering transcript and graduation planner.
- [Model Mission](https://eng-asl.com/tools/ai-script-generator/): Guided computer vision project builder with YOLO26, YOLOE open-vocabulary detection, monocular depth, and U-Net segmentation examples.
- [Sensor Code Generator](https://eng-asl.com/tools/sensor-code-generator/): Arduino, ESP-IDF, and PlatformIO code for sensors, I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, ESP-NOW, and other embedded interfaces.
- [PID Simulator](https://eng-asl.com/tools/pid-simulator/): Interactive proportional, integral, and derivative controller tuning.
- [Battery Life Estimator](https://eng-asl.com/tools/battery-estimator/): ESP32 runtime and average-current estimates from active and sleep duty cycles.
- [Security Mission](https://eng-asl.com/tools/security-command-builder/): Guided command builder for authorized security labs.

## Areas of work

- Embedded firmware in C and C++ for ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, and AVR systems.
- IoT architecture, device connectivity, telemetry, networking, Linux, and Python.
- Robotics, sensor integration, secure access systems, and remotely operated vehicles.
- Flutter control interfaces, UI and UX design, and technical communication.
- University teaching in satellite communication, acoustics, digital and logic circuits, measurement, and sensors.

## Writing series

- OverTheWire Bandit walkthroughs: Linux, SSH, files, permissions, processes, and networking.
- Learn With Me: Linux, Python, Dart and Flutter, and Git.
